title: Build the optional whole-service Go cargohold candidate

acceptance_criteria.description: Runnable optional whole-service implementation preserves the approved HTTP, federation, S3, configuration and operational boundaries.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: Complete implementation against the existing matrix with exact binary/source identities; no Haskell defaults or oracle edits.

acceptance_criteria.description: Candidate formatting, build, vet, unit/race/security and dependency checks pass.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: Actual Go check output and retained evidence. Whole-service parity/switchback verification remains separately owned.

evidence.command: Initial candidate Go module passes go/check.py cargohold (format/tidy/verify/vet/race/build/module vulnerability and license checks). Real private S3 smoke passes 6 existing multipart captures plus signed read/delete effects; exact binary source and identity retained. This is initial-slice evidence, not completion or full-service parity.

handoff: Active whole-service candidate: original 27 compiled Haskell cargo tests pass at f410fca816fdca360720ca3565143a88a49185a7 with Go selected for cargo static/dynamic domains and all other services Haskell; same baseline fixtures, exit/cleanup zero. User/Brig/token/version/legacy/federation/audit metadata routes implemented; subsequent CloudFront/config/domain/HEAD source alignment has focused checks. Audit logs, exact parser/failure semantics, operational/config variants, packaging and finite supplemental/mixed-cargo/switchback validation remain. Full compatibility not claimed.
